title: Pixel Hop
text: A test cartridge for the demo catalog: 32 KB of zeros. The launcher copies it into your Game Boy folder, adds its cover and its entry, and it shows in the list at once.

title: Blue Lines
text: Another test cartridge. Remove it from here: the launcher asks first, and only takes away the games this module installed.

title: Red Shift
text: The third test cartridge, for the list to scroll.

title: Violet Sky
text: The fourth one comes only when the list reaches its end: the launcher asks for more with screen.more.
